# TAR System Instructions

- Paper mode only. Never add live trading.
- Do not add broker execution.
- Do not export to MT5 automatically.
- Do not install tools or dependencies without explicit permission.
- Do not use gh unless a PR URL or PR number is provided.
- For reviews, default to local git diff and local files.
- Inspect before editing.
- Patch only what is needed.
- Never overwrite raw data in data/raw.
- Never score or write memory from partial, blocked, or stopped runs.
- Keep changes small and tested.
